1.text: Yosefu ananirwa kwiyumanganya imbere y'abo bahagararanye bose, ahubwo avuga cyane ati “Nimusohore abantu bose bambise.” Ntihagira umuntu uhagararana na Yosefu, yirondorera bene se.

2.text: Atera hejuru ararira, Abanyegiputa barabyumva, abo mu nzu ya Farawo barabyumva.

3.text: Yosefu abwira bene se ati “Ndi Yosefu. Data aracyariho?” Bene se bashaka icyo bamusubiza kirabura, kuko bahagaritswe imitima no kuba imbere ye.

4.text: Yosefu abwira bene se ati “Ndabinginze nimunyegere.” Baramwegera aravuga ati “Ndi Yosefu mwene so, mwaguze ngo njyanwe muri Egiputa.

5.text: None ntimubabare, ntimwirakaririre yuko mwanguze ngo nzanwe ino, kuko Imana ari yo yatumye mbabanziriza ngo nkize ubugingo bw'abantu.

6.text: Inzara imaze imyaka ibiri mu gihugu, hasigaye indi myaka itanu, batazahingiramo ntibasaruriremo.

7.text: Kandi Imana yatumye mbabanziriza ngo ibabesheho mugire icyo musiga mu isi, ibarokoze gukiza gukomeye.

8.text: Nuko none si mwe mwanyohereje ino ahubwo ni Imana, kandi yangize nka se wa Farawo n'umutegeka w'urugo rwe rwose, n'umutware w'igihugu cya Egiputa cyose.

9.text: “Nimwihute, muzamuke mujye kuri data mumubwire muti ‘Umwana wawe Yosefu ngo tukubwire yuko Imana yamugize umutware wa Egiputa hose, manuka umusange ntutinde.

10.text: Kandi uzatura mu gihugu cy'i Gosheni, umube bugufi, wowe n'abana bawe n'abuzukuru bawe, n'imikumbi yawe n'amashyo yawe, n'ibyo ufite byose.

11.text: Kandi ngo azakugerererayo, kuko hagisigaye imyaka itanu y'inzara, we gukenana n'inzu yawe n'ibyo ufite byose.’

12.text: “Kandi murirebera, na mwene mama Benyamini arirebera, yuko ari jye ubyikuriye mu kanwa.

13.text: Kandi muzabwire data icyubahiro cyanjye cyose mfite muri Egiputa, muzamubwire ibyo mwabonye byose, kandi muzatebutse data mumuzane ino.”

14.text: Yosefu ahobera mwene nyina Benyamini, begamiranya amajosi ararira, Benyamini aririra ku ijosi rya Yosefu.

15.text: Asoma bene se bose, abaririraho, nyuma bene se baganira na we.

16.text: Inkuru y'ibyo igera kwa Farawo yuko bene se wa Yosefu baje, binezeza Farawo n'abagaragu be cyane.

17.text: Farawo abwira Yosefu ati “Bwira bene so ngo nimugenze mutya: muhekeshe indogobe zanyu imitwaro, mugende mujye mu gihugu cy'i Kanāni,

18.text: muzane so n'abo mu ngo zanyu, muze iwe, ngo na we azabaha ibyiza byo mu gihugu cya Egiputa, muzarya ibirushaho kuba byiza byo mu gihugu.

19.text: Ndagutegetse kubabwira uti ‘Nimugenze mutya: mujyane amagare yo mu gihugu cya Egiputa yo gushyiramo abana banyu bato n'abagore banyu, muzane na so, muze ino.

20.text: Kandi ntimwite ku bintu byanyu, kuko ibyiza byo mu gihugu cya Egiputa cyose ari ibyanyu.’ ”

21.text: Abana ba Isirayeli babigenza batyo. Yosefu abaha amagare nk'uko Farawo yategetse, abaha n'impamba.

22.text: Kandi uko bangana, aha umuntu wese imyenda yo gukuranwa, ariko aha Benyamini ibice by'ifeza magana atatu, amuha n'imyenda yo gukuranwa gatanu.

23.text: Na se amwoherereza izi ntashyo: indogobe cumi zihetse ibyiza bya Egiputa, n'indogobe z'ingore cumi zihetse imyaka y'impeke, n'imitsima n'ibyokurya bindi by'impamba bya se.

24.text: Nuko asezerera bene se, bagenda ababwiye ati “Mwirinde, ntimutonganire mu nzira.”

25.text: Bava muri Egiputa barazamuka, bagera mu gihugu cy'i Kanāni kuri se Yakobo.

26.text: Baramubwira bati “Yosefu aracyariho, ni we mutware w'igihugu cya Egiputa cyose.” Yakobo arakakara, kuko atabemereye.

27.text: Bamubwira amagambo yose Yosefu yabatumye. Abonye ya magare Yosefu yohereje kumuhagurutsa, umutima wa se wabo Yakobo urahembūka,

28.text: Isirayeli aravuga ati “Ni byo bizi! Yosefu umwana wanjye aracyariho, ndajya kubonana na we ntarapfa.”
